name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 9
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.9
source:
Akira wanted to compete alongside Seraia in the grand tournament but, lacking funds to pay the entry fee, resorted resort to smaller battles. On the morning of his event he found out from Kyoka that a player from the same school was also participating.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE146352.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
阿基拉（Akira）想与塞拉亚（Seraia）一起参加盛大的锦标赛，但由于缺乏资金支付报名费，只好诉诸较小的战斗。比赛当天早上，他从京花那里得知，同校的一名选手也参加了比赛。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE146352.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
